MobileScannerSyncBatch.title: Mobile Scanner Sync Batch
MobileScannerSyncBatch.description: Server-side record of a single POST /api/v1/inventory/sync upload from the warehouse mobile PWA. Stores the (transactionId, operationType, userId, occurredAt) tuple so the server can deduplicate retried uploads within the 24h dedup window per REQ-SYNC-001 / REQ-SYNC-002. One MobileScannerSyncBatch row is written per accepted pendingOp; replays of the same transactionId return the original ACK without re-applying mutations. Purged on the 24h+ dedup cron.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this sync batch. Tenant-scoped for IDOR-safe deduplication.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

transactionId.description: Client-generated UUID (RFC 4122) used as the dedup key. Re-uploads of the same transactionId return the original ACK without re-applying the mutation.
transactionId.title: Transaction ID

operationType.description: Type of warehouse operation this batch executed.
operationType.title: Operation Type

sku.description: SKU touched by the operation (informational; the canonical mutation lives in InventoryStock).
sku.title: SKU

location.description: Primary location for the operation (source for transfers).
location.title: Location

quantityDelta.description: Quantity change applied. Positive for receive/transfer-to/count-up, negative for pick/transfer-from.
quantityDelta.title: Quantity Delta

userId.description: Nextcloud user id of the warehouse operator that submitted the batch.
userId.title: User ID

occurredAt.description: Client-reported timestamp at which the operation was completed locally (ISO 8601 UTC).
occurredAt.title: Occurred At

ackedAt.description: Server timestamp at which the ACK was issued.
ackedAt.title: Acked At

rejectionReason.description: Human-readable rejection reason when status is rejected_*.
rejectionReason.title: Rejection Reason

GoodsReceipt.title: Goods Receipt
GoodsReceipt.description: Audit record produced by the warehouse receive operation. Captures (sku, location, quantity, occurredAt, userId) so receiving history is auditable independently of the mutable InventoryStock ledger. One GoodsReceipt row per accepted receive sync batch.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns the receipt.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

location.description: Location code at which the goods were received (e.g. WH-A1).
location.title: Location

quantity.description: Quantity received. Always positive (decrements are modelled as InventoryTransfer or OrderPick).
quantity.title: Quantity

userId.description: Nextcloud user id of the warehouse manager that recorded the receipt.
userId.title: User ID

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the receive operation was completed (ISO 8601 UTC).
occurredAt.title: Occurred At

transactionId.description: Client transactionId that produced this receipt (for cross-referencing the sync batch).
transactionId.title: Transaction ID

InventoryTransfer.title: Inventory Transfer
InventoryTransfer.description: Atomic record of a warehouse transfer operation: one row captures the source location, destination location and quantity moved. Mirrors the (-qty at source, +qty at destination) pair of InventoryStock mutations that the transfer batch applied per REQ-INVENTORY-002.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns the transfer.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

quantity.description: Quantity transferred. Must be strictly positive; the controller rejects zero or negative.
quantity.title: Quantity

userId.description: Nextcloud user id of the operator that recorded the transfer.
userId.title: User ID

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the transfer was completed (ISO 8601 UTC).
occurredAt.title: Occurred At

transactionId.description: Client transactionId that produced this transfer.
transactionId.title: Transaction ID

OrderPick.title: Order Pick
OrderPick.description: Record of a pick operation: an InventoryStock decrement plus the order line item marked as picked. Captures (sku, location, quantity, userId, orderLineId?, occurredAt). Idempotent against the same transactionId per REQ-SYNC-001.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns the pick record.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

location.description: Location code from which the stock was picked.
location.title: Location

quantity.description: Quantity picked. Must be strictly positive.
quantity.title: Quantity

orderLineId.description: Optional FK to the order line that this pick fulfils.
orderLineId.title: Order Line ID

userId.description: Nextcloud user id of the operator that recorded the pick.
userId.title: User ID

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the pick was completed (ISO 8601 UTC).
occurredAt.title: Occurred At

transactionId.description: Client transactionId that produced this pick.
transactionId.title: Transaction ID

InventoryCount.title: Inventory Count
InventoryCount.description: Record of a physical inventory count against system quantity, capturing variance for reconciliation. Counts are reference points and never auto-correct InventoryStock; operators approve a reconcile mutation separately per REQ-INVENTORY-004.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns the count.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

location.description: Location code at which the physical count was performed.
location.title: Location

systemQuantity.description: Quantity reported by InventoryStock at the moment the count was recorded.
systemQuantity.title: System Quantity

physicalQuantity.description: Physical quantity entered by the counter.
physicalQuantity.title: Physical Quantity

variance.description: physicalQuantity - systemQuantity. Negative variance = system overstates.
variance.title: Variance

reconciled.description: True when the operator approved updating InventoryStock to physicalQuantity. False = variance recorded only.
reconciled.title: Reconciled

userId.description: Nextcloud user id of the counter that recorded the count.
userId.title: User ID

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the count was performed (ISO 8601 UTC).
occurredAt.title: Occurred At

transactionId.description: Client transactionId that produced this count.
transactionId.title: Transaction ID
